playground.label: Postcode
playground.hint: Type or paste a postcode, such as ek 01 a03 fk 01. Nothing you type leaves this page.
playground.idle: The playground checks the form of the text as you type.
result.unit: The text has the form of a postcode. Only NIPOST's gateway can say whether a building has it.
result.partial: The text has the form of a partial postcode.
error.legacy_code: This is an old 6-digit postcode. Ask for the new postcode of 11 letters and digits.
error.bad_character: A postcode holds only letters and digits.
error.bad_length: A postcode has 11 letters and digits.
error.bad_length.partial: A partial postcode has 2, 4, 7 or 9 letters and digits.
error.unknown_state: The first two letters do not name a state.
error.bad_segment.lga: The LGA is two digits from 01 to 99.
error.bad_segment.district: The district is three letters or digits.
error.bad_segment.unit: The unit is two digits from 01 to 99.
accuracy.label: GPS accuracy in metres
accuracy.hint: A phone reports the accuracy of each GPS fix.
accuracy.lga: A fix this rough can show the postcode up to the LGA.
accuracy.district: A fix of this accuracy can show the postcode up to the district.
accuracy.area: A fix of this accuracy can show the postcode up to the area.
accuracy.unit: A fix of this accuracy can show the whole postcode, with the unit.
playground.noScript: The playground needs JavaScript. The guides show the same results.
accuracy.heading: Match a GPS fix
